# BarcodeElement

**Class:** `UltraCanvasBarcodeElement` · **Group:** [Codes and documents](../Groups/Codes-and-documents.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Barcode/UltraCanvasBarcodeElement.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Barcode/UltraCanvasBarcodeElement.h) · `#include "Plugins/Barcode/UltraCanvasBarcodeElement.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

A 1D barcode (EAN, UPC, Code 39/128, ITF, Codabar …) with its human-readable line

## Guides and examples

The component documentation with explained, compiled C++ examples:

- [UltraCanvasBarcodeElement](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasBarcodeElement.md)
- [UltraCanvasQRCodeExamples](../../UltraCanvas/UltraCanvasQRCodeExamples.md)

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasBarcodeElement> CreateBarcode( const std::string& identifier, long x, long y, long w, long h, BarcodeSymbology symbology, const std::string& data);
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasBarcodeElement> CreateBarcode( const std::string& identifier, long w, long h, BarcodeSymbology symbology, const std::string& data);
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasBarcodeElement(const std::string& identifier, long x, long y, long w, long h);
explicit UltraCanvasBarcodeElement(const std::string& identifier = "Barcode", long w = 240, long h = 100);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Callbacks

Assign a lambda to the member (or call the setter). Capture the element and its parents **raw**, never as a `shared_ptr` - see [Events and callbacks](../Events-and-Callbacks.md#ownership).

| Callback | Signature | When it fires |
|---|---|---|
| `onError` | `std::function<void(const std::string& )> onError` | _Error_ |
| `onEncoded` | `std::function<void()> onEncoded` | _Encoded_ |
| `onClick` | `std::function<void()> onClick` | _Click_ |

**Inherited callbacks:**

- from [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md): `eventCallback`, `onPopupAboutToClose`, `onPopupClosed`, `onPopupOpened`, `SetEventCallback`

## Option types in this header

### enum `BarcodeTextPosition`

Suffixed because X11/Xlib.h defines Above/Below as preprocessor macros.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `HiddenText` |  |
| `TextBelow` |  |
| `TextAbove` |  |
| `TextBothSides` |  |

### enum `BarcodeRotation`

The renderer composes the bars in normal orientation and rotates the whole thing as a final step.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Rotate0` |  |
| `Rotate90` |  |
| `Rotate180` |  |
| `Rotate270` |  |
